problem_statement.value: Operations analysts manually triage internal access-related tickets and copy data between ServiceNow and an entitlement portal.

goal.value: Reduce triage time while retaining human approval for entitlement changes.

trigger.value: A ticket enters the ACCESS TRIAGE assignment group.

value: Analyst looks up the requester in the entitlement portal
Analyst records the decision and routes the ticket

outcome.value: The ticket is routed to fulfilment or returned for missing information with the decision recorded.

annual_manual_hours.notes: Estimated from 8,000 tickets at 24 minutes each; validate with ServiceNow timestamps and sampling.

measurement_plan.value: Query twelve months of ticket counts, assignment history, reassignment counts, and resolution timestamps for the approved assignment group; validate handling time through a two-week sample.
measurement_plan.notes: No individual ticket text is required for the aggregate baseline.

pain_severity_1_to_5.notes: Requester rating; confirm with analyst survey.

strategic_alignment_1_to_5.notes: Mapped to the unit plan in this synthetic example.

reuse_potential_1_to_5.notes: Could apply to other structured triage queues; not yet assessed.

available_interfaces.notes: Interface availability does not imply project access.

highest_classification.value: Internal confidential with employee identifiers; privileged-access cases require additional handling.
highest_classification.notes: Formal privacy and security confirmation required.

value: Ticket metadata and approved form fields

human_oversight_1_to_5.notes: A person approves all entitlement changes.

decision_reversibility_1_to_5.notes: Triage routing is reversible; fulfilment is outside the pilot.

audit_requirements.value: Record input references, extracted fields, rules applied, model and prompt versions, confidence, tool calls, human edits, approval, and final routing.
audit_requirements.notes: Retention period remains to be confirmed.

access_readiness_1_to_5.notes: APIs exist but service accounts and scopes are not approved.

user_journey.value: An analyst opens a triage work item containing validated ticket fields, directory matches, missing-information flags, and a proposed category. The analyst corrects or accepts the proposal and routes it to the existing approver.
user_journey.notes: Desired experience, not a deployed capability.

value: Retrieve approved directory and catalogue metadata
Propose category and routing with confidence
automation_boundary.notes: Proposed future state requiring architecture and control review.

fallback_path.value: If a lookup fails, required data is absent, or confidence is below the approved threshold, send the case to the current manual triage queue without taking an action.

channels.notes: A separate chat interface is not preferred for operational triage.

primary_metric.value: Median analyst handling time per triage ticket

baseline.value: Not yet verified; initial estimate is 24 minutes per ticket.

target.value: At least 30 percent lower median handling time over an eight-week pilot, with no increase in incorrect routing or control exceptions.

pilot_scope.value: One assignment group, two common non-privileged request categories, five analysts, and shadow mode before assisted routing.
